name: wait_ticks
description:
Hold every current command and let time pass.
Use when: the scene has to change without a robot command -- something is still settling, or the instruction says to wait. It is not a correction: a pose error needs move_pose, a jaw that stopped needs set_gripper.
Effect: world mutation by elapsed time only. Every arm and gripper target is held unchanged; one tick is one 20 ms control period, at most 20 per call. One call is one robot decision.
Returns: status=submitted immediately. The next receipt reports the ticks used; the fresh observation shows what changed.
Does not: move toward any target, open or close a gripper, or establish that the scene finished changing.
On error: invalid_arguments names the ticks bound. For more time call wait_ticks again.

ticks.description: Control ticks to hold every current command. One tick is 20 ms; 20 ticks is 0.4 s. Required.
